source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Chapter 13 1-12 + Chapter 14 1
claim_en: THE SPECIES AND WORK GATE. Wool/linen as-created; the work-finished thresholds; the land-thread rule; tents in; the uprooter-of-mountains exchange.
middah: plain (the species and work gate — wool and linen as created, the work-finished thresholds, tents in; the uprooter-of-mountains exchange)

claim_en: THE INTENSEST SHADES. Green-of-greens, red-of-reds; they combine; at the bean; fringes out.
middah: ink (the reduplicated color forms read — green of greens, red of reds; they combine; at the bean; fringes out)

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Chapter 14 9-11 + Onkelos Lev 13:51-52
claim_en: THE BENEFIT BAN. Malignant = cursed-for-loss (Onkelos: causes loss); the decided stays banned even shredded; the three spread grades.
middah: M-09 (malignant read as cursed-for-loss, the received translation's 'causes loss'; the decided stays banned even shredded; the three spread grades)

source: Sifra, Tazria Parashat Nega'im, Chapter 2* 8 + Chapter 15 7-9 + Chapter 16 1-9 + Onkelos Lev 13:55
claim_en: STANDING BURNS. The garment/person asymmetry; worn-or-new performed by Onkelos; the tear-and-patch grid; the striped-garment exchange.
middah: plain (standing burns — the garment-person asymmetry; worn-or-new performed by the received translation, ink, beside; the tear-and-patch grid; the striped-garment exchange)

claim_en: THE CLOSE. Second washing purifies; gone means gone; entry-defilement like the house; abroad alike; one priest for both verdicts.
middah: plain (the close — the second washing purifies, gone means gone, entry-defilement like the house, abroad alike, one priest for both verdicts)
